program_name: Diploma in Public Relations and Entertainment Management

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM57,645. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0006062/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM or its equivalent with 3 credits; OR Certificate from Polytechnic/private higher learning institution (IPTS) and other qualifications recognized by MSU Senate; OR Pass Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least grade B in 3 subjects; OR Other equivalent qualifications recognized by the Malaysian Government
